Grounded poses share one floor line near the bottom. Background: one perfectly flat solid chroma green #00B140 everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders, no text. Where a limb or weapon moves fast draw a SMEAR (stretched streaky ribbon) plus 3-6 crisp white motion arcs, kept inside that pose's column.
